Continue.description: Indicates to continue a previously failed build attempt

Help.description: Shows the help text for this build assembly

Skip.description: List of targets to be skipped. Empty list skips all dependencies

Target.description: List of targets to be invoked. Default is '{default_target}'

Verbosity.description: Logging verbosity during build execution. Default is 'Normal'

BuildProjectFile.description: Path to the build project (.csproj) relative to the repository root. Defaults to 'build/_build.csproj' when unset. Read by the Fallout global tool's in-tool runner.

CoverageBadgeDirectory.description: Directory, relative to the root, to write coverage-badge.svg and coverage-badge.json to; empty = no badge

CoverageExcludeExternalParam.description: Exclude code built elsewhere: SourceLink paths (/_/...) of dependencies the coverage tool instrumented (true/false)

CoverageExcludeGeneratedParam.description: Exclude generated files, migrations, GlobalUsings.cs, Program.cs (true/false)

CoverageExcludeTestCodeParam.description: Exclude test projects and fixtures: *.Tests/, TestSupport/, TestFixtures/ (true/false)

CoverageJsonPath.description: File, relative to the root, to also write the JSON report with its gate to, for every outcome; empty = none

CoverageMaxCharsParam.description: Per-file XML character cap; 0 = no cap

CoveragePattern.description: Report file name pattern: 'filename' or '**/filename' (gcovr and coverage.py emit coverage.xml)

CoverageProbeSourcesParam.description: Resolve a relative filename under several <source> roots against the root that holds it on this machine's disk (true/false)

CoverageSourceRoot.description: Resolve a relative filename under several <source> roots against this declared root
